name: Villar de Domingo García (Spain)
description: Vertically divided yellow and blue, the blue charged with the crowned municipal arms of Villar de Domingo García (a fleur-de-lis, a castle and a spade on blue and yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Villar de Domingo García; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villar de Domingo García arms — fleur-de-lis, castle and spade
